description: This file defines the 'TalkAudioPlayer' class, a singleton responsible for playing audio data asynchronously using AVFoundation's AVAudioPlayer. It manages playback state, handles delegate callbacks, and includes watchdog logic to monitor playback timing and detect playback issues.

classes.name: TalkAudioPlayer
classes.description: A singleton class managing audio playback, including starting, stopping, and monitoring audio via AVAudioPlayer. It incorporates logging and concurrency handling with continuations and watchdog timers.

classes.name: Playback
classes.description: A nested class within TalkAudioPlayer that manages the continuation and watchdog task for a single playback session, ensuring thread safety and proper lifecycle management.

methods.name: play(data: Data) async -> TalkPlaybackResult
methods.description: Asynchronously plays provided audio data, managing state and monitoring playback progress.

methods.name: stop() -> Double?
methods.description: Stops current playback if any and returns the current playback time.

methods.name: audioPlayerDidFinishPlaying(_:successfully:)
methods.description: Delegate method called when audio playback finishes successfully or due to interruption.

methods.name: stopInternal(finished: Bool, interruptedAt: Double?)
methods.description: Internal method to stop playback and finalize the playback result.

methods.name: finish(playback: Playback, result: TalkPlaybackResult)
methods.description: Completes the playback session, cancels watchdogs, resumes continuations, and cleans up state.

methods.name: armWatchdog(playback: Playback)
methods.description: Sets up a watchdog task to monitor playback health and trigger fallback if playback stalls or takes too long.
